relations: As her body and head pivot, her orientation shifts to present a right-facing profile against the bright light.
The swaying motion causes her long hair to slide and swing, settling once she holds the profile.
Near the end, she lifts an arm, bringing her hand up to rest against her head and face.
caption: In a hazy, dimly lit space, a woman with long dark hair and sunglasses perched on her head stands before two horizontal neon tubes, a blue one above a pink one on the left. A warm spotlight glows on the right, and she wears a dark low-cut top. She sways gently while facing the lens. Over the first second her body and head pivot slowly to her left, turning her into a right-facing profile. Her hair slides and swings with the motion, then settles as she holds the profile against the bright light through the middle of the clip. Near the end she lifts an arm, bringing her hand up to her head and face, where it remains at the cut.
